rows.note: This is the everyday colloquial word for female breasts, though it can sound blunt or informal.

example.english: They said one breast had gotten bigger.
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 bin1 bo1 daai6 zo2

rows.note: Use this precise anatomical term instead of colloquial 波 in medical or neutral descriptions of a female breast.

example.english: The doctor said there is a lump in my breast and it needs to be checked immediately.
example.traditional: 醫生話我嘅乳房有硬塊，要即刻檢查。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 jyu5 fong4 jau5 ngaang6 faai3 jiu3 zik1 hak1 gim2 caa4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the front of the chest.

example.english: My chest hurts a bit after running, especially near my breast.
example.traditional: 我跑完步胸口有啲痛，尤其係近乳房嗰邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 hung1 hau2 jau5 di1 tung3 jau4 kei4 hai6 gan6 jyu5 fong4 go2 bin1

rows.note: Use this for poultry breast meat when the bird is clear from context, as in choosing breast rather than wing.

example.english: I want chicken breast, not the wing.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 gai1 hung1 m4 jiu3 gai1 jik6
